lessons.title: Introduction to React
lessons.content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It allows developers to create reusable UI components and build modern web applications efficiently.

lessons.title: JSX Fundamentals
lessons.content: JSX is a syntax extension for JavaScript that allows you to write HTML-like code inside JavaScript.

lessons.title: Components and Props
lessons.content: Components let you split the UI into independent and reusable pieces. Props are used to pass data between components.

lessons.title: State and Events
lessons.content: State allows React components to manage changing data. Events help users interact with the application.

lessons.title: React Router Basics
lessons.content: React Router enables navigation between pages in a React application.

lessons.title: Variables and Data Types
lessons.content: Variables store data values. JavaScript supports numbers, strings, booleans, arrays and objects.

lessons.title: Functions

lessons.title: Arrays and Objects
lessons.content: Arrays store collections of values while objects store key-value pairs.

lessons.title: DOM Manipulation
